question: Duniya ka sabse bada janwar kaun sa hai?
voice_hint: Ye zameen par nahi, samundar me rehti hai!
explanation: Blue Whale samundar aur poori duniya ka sabse bada jeev hai.

question: Duniya ka sabse tez daudne wala janwar kaun sa hai?
voice_hint: Iski body par black spots hote hain!
explanation: Cheetah 110 se 120 km/hr ki speed se daud sakta hai.

question: Jungle ka raja kise kaha jata hai?
voice_hint: Iski gardan par bade baal (mane) hote hain aur ye tez dahadta hai!
explanation: Sher (Lion) ko jungle ka raja kaha jata hai.

question: Kaun sa pakshi peechhe ki taraf bhi ud sakta hai?
voice_hint: Ye phoolon ka ras peeta hai aur bahut chhota hota hai!
explanation: Hummingbird aage aur peeche dono dishao me ud sakta hai.

question: Solar system me 'Red Planet' (Laal Grah) kise kehte hain?
voice_hint: Is par ISRO ka Mangalyaan mission gaya tha!
explanation: Mars (Mangal) ki mitti me iron oxide hone se wo laal dikhta hai.

question: Duniya ki sabse paas wali star (sitara) kaun si hai?
voice_hint: Ye din me aasman me chamakta hai aur hume roshni deta hai!
explanation: Suraj (Sun) hamari zameen ke sabse kareeb ka tara hai.

question: Chaand (Moon) par sabse pehla kadam kisne rakha tha?
voice_hint: Unhone saal 1969 me Apollo 11 mission se chaand par kadam rakha tha!
explanation: Neil Armstrong ne chaand par sabse pehla kadam rakha tha.

question: Batao: 5 aur 5 kitne hote hain?
voice_hint: Dono haathon ki ungliyon ko gino!

question: Ek triangle (tribhuj) me kitne sides (bhujaayein) hoti hain?
voice_hint: Tri ka matlab hota hai teen!

question: Agar aapke paas 6 chocolate hain aur aapne 2 khaa li, to kitni bachi?
Aisi kaun si cheez hai jiske paas do haath hain par taali nahi baja sakti?
voice_hint: Ye deewar par latakti hai aur samay batati hai!
explanation: Ghadi (Clock) ke paas ghante aur minute ki sui hoti hai jinhe hands kehte hain.

question: Aisi kaun si cheez hai jiske paas daant hain par wo kaat nahi sakti?
voice_hint: Isse hum subah apne baal banate hain!
explanation: Kanghi (Comb) ke teethes hote hain par wo kaat nahi sakti.

question: Bharat ka National Fruit (Rashtriya Phal) kaun sa hai?
voice_hint: Ise phalon ka raja bhi kehte hain, peela peela meetha meetha!
explanation: Aam (Mango) Bharat ka rashtriya phal hai.

question: Rainbow (Indradhanush) me kitne colours hote hain?
explanation: Indradhanush me total 7 rang hote hain.

question: Ek saal me kitne mahine (months) hote hain?
voice_hint: January se shuru hokar December tak gino!
explanation: Ek saal me 12 mahine hote hain.

question: Paudhe (Plants) din me kaun si gas chhodte hain jo hum saans lene ke liye use karte hain?
voice_hint: Ye gas hamare jeene ke liye sabse zaroori hai!
explanation: Paudhe photosynthesis me Oxygen chhodte hain.

question: Paani (Water) ka scientific formula kya hota hai?
voice_hint: Isme 2 Hydrogen aur 1 Oxygen hota hai!
explanation: Water ka chemical formula H2O hota hai.
